preregistration.fixed_on: 2026-11-04, before any candle of a new market was collected (plan row R12)
preregistration.question: Do the Sprint 2c rule families hold on large OKX spot USDT markets they were never tuned on, or are they BTC-specific?
preregistration.markets: the top 6 of the candidates with public 1H candles from before 2020-01-01 (XRP, LTC, ADA, LINK, BCH, DOGE, TRX, ETC, XLM, ATOM, ALGO), ranked by public 24-hour quote volume (OKX /api/v5/market/tickers, SPOT, volCcy24h) at one snapshot taken before any collection, plus SOL-USDT; the snapshot, the ranking and the chosen list are stored in docs/research/replication_v1d_preregistration.json
preregistration.configurations: exactly Sprint 2c's: S1, S1+S5, S2, S2+S5 x 4H/6H x regime none/gate = 16 judged configurations per market; hold + policy sizing and plain buy-and-hold as the controls (never judged, as in Sprint 2c); parameters, grids, brackets (none/tp2/trail1/time30; none for the S5 families), the S0 filter with the FOMC calendar, the fixed policy sizing vt10/30 crash15/90dh ladder (rebalance 0.25, ladder re-arm 30 days), the regime-v2 entry gate (3-state HMM on returns and 7-day vol, bear >= 0.5, fitted on every window's train slice), the walk-forward (train 540 d, purge 7 d, test 180 d, Sharpe with >= 20 train trades, entries then bracket) and the v1c gates — run by scripts/run_research_v1c.py's own run_series, not by a copy of it
preregistration.data: OKX public 1H and 4H spot candles through the GET-only lake client (4H stored, 6H resampled from 1H, as Sprint 2c's BTC/ETH data); every market's candles end where Sprint 2c's did (bar close <= 2026-10-20T10:00:00+00:00), so the untouched 12 months are the same calendar window, 2025-10-20 -> 2026-10-20; Binance public funding of the market's USDT perpetual as the S5 feature, through the research symbol table; the new markets have no open-interest history, so that leg of the S5 filter passes (as it does wherever data is missing); a market whose funding covers less than 90 % of its in-sample bars (Sprint 2b item 6) has its S5 configurations reported as 'run without S5' and never counted for the S1+S5 / S2+S5 families
preregistration.reproduction: before any new market is judged, the same code path re-runs BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT (the 16 configurations and the hold control) and must give Sprint 2c's stored walk-forward numbers to 6 decimals, the same trade counts, the same most-selected rules and the same gate verdicts; otherwise the study stops
preregistration.primary_test: the configurations that passed every gate on BTC-USDT in Sprint 2c (taken from the stored results: S2 4H gate, S2+S5 4H gate, S1+S5 6H none) run unchanged on every new market; a configuration 'replicates' when it passes all v1c gates on at least half of the new markets
preregistration.family_verdicts: per family (S1, S1+S5, S2, S2+S5), a market counts when any of the family's four configurations passes all gates there: 'robust across markets' = at least half of the new markets; 'fragile' = at least one but fewer than half; 'BTC-specific' = none, for a family that passed on BTC in Sprint 2c; 'fails everywhere' = none, and it did not pass on BTC either
preregistration.overall_verdict: 'robust across markets' if any family is robust; 'fragile' if some configuration passes on a new market but no family is robust; 'BTC-specific' if no configuration passes on any new market
preregistration.holdout: each new market's last 12 months (2025-10-20 -> 2026-10-20), opened once, only for a configuration that passes every walk-forward gate on that market, and only by the full pre-registered study (every chosen market, family, timeframe and mode, no --quick); the v1c verdict (positive return, PF > 1, >= 10 trades); the hold + policy control's 12 months are evaluated on every market as the comparison line, as Sprint 2c did (a reference, not a configuration under test); every opening goes into an append-only ledger the report shows; the new markets' price moves over those months were not looked at before the run
preregistration.fleet: a configuration confirmed by its holdout on a new market is added to the paper fleet's shortlist as a new account with a source tag (existing entries and running accounts untouched); a walk-forward pass alone adds nothing
preregistration.no_changes_after_results: no gate, parameter, market, threshold or verdict rule changes after the results are in; if a gate looks wrong the report says so
